definitions.explanation: Iron as a nutritional element found in food. Refers specifically to the mineral content, not the metal itself.

examples.japanese: {鉄分|てつぶん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{足|た}りない→足りる：01209_tariru⟧。
⟦ほうれん{草|そう}→ほうれん草：05188_hourensou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{鉄分|てつぶん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{豊富|ほうふ}→豊富：03620_houfu⟧だ。
⟦{貧血|ひんけつ}→貧血：07019_hinketsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{防|ふせ}ぐ→防ぐ：02409_fusegu⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{鉄分|てつぶん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{多|おお}く→多い：01127_ooi⟧⟦{取|と}る→取る：00565_toru⟧ようにして⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: I try to take in a lot of iron to prevent anemia.

examples.japanese: {妊娠中|にんしんちゅう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{鉄分|てつぶん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{摂取|せっしゅ}→摂取：09322_sesshu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{特|とく}に→特に：01260_tokuni⟧⟦{大切|たいせつ}→大切：01456_taisetsu⟧です。
examples.english: Intake of iron is especially important during pregnancy.

notes:
{鉄分|てつぶん} refers specifically to iron as a dietary nutrient, not to the metal ⟦{鉄|てつ}→鉄：02225_tetsu⟧ itself. It appears frequently in health and nutrition contexts.

FORMS:
⟦{鉄|てつ}→鉄：02225_tetsu⟧ (iron) + ⟦{分|ぶん}→分：26216_bun⟧ (portion, content). The ～⟦{分|ぶん}→分：26216_bun⟧ suffix works the same way as in ⟦{水分|すいぶん}→水分：04302_suibun⟧ (moisture), ⟦{塩分|えんぶん}→塩分：09945_enbun⟧ (salt content), and ⟦{糖分|とうぶん}→糖分：15847_toubun⟧ (sugar content).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {鉄分|てつぶん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}る→取る：00565_toru⟧: to take in iron
- {鉄分|てつぶん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{足|た}りない→足りる：01209_tariru⟧: to lack iron
- {鉄分|てつぶん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{豊富|ほうふ}→豊富：03620_houfu⟧: rich in iron
- {鉄分|てつぶん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{補|おぎな}う→補う：00329_oginau⟧: to supplement iron
- {鉄分|てつぶん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{摂取|せっしゅ}→摂取：09322_sesshu⟧: iron intake

USAGE:
{鉄分|てつぶん}{不足|ぶそく} (iron deficiency) is linked to ⟦{貧血|ひんけつ}→貧血：07019_hinketsu⟧ (anemia), a common health topic in Japan, particularly for women.
